Refuse group-specific parameters that the target cannot identify

Source: R/06-ae_targets.R
dot-check_group_targets.Rd

A model with demand groups fitted with free group-specific parameters (sigma.<g>, v0.<g>) needs group-labelled targets: utilization_by_group (or utilization_outside_by_group, whose outside row does not count as an observed facility cell) with observed counts for every group that has such a parameter, and positive demand in that group. Aggregated targets leave the group parameters multimodal and weakly identified (SPAX-057, D2). Fixed group parameters and shared parameters are allowed with any target; ungrouped problems return at once. The check runs inside .bind_problem_target(), in both its branches, so every fitting path (multistart, profile, nfxp, ladder, bootstrap and inference refits) refuses once, before any start. Group-specific free parameters are read from the names of the theta contract (a profile subproblem rebuilds the contract from its names alone).

Usage

.check_group_targets(problem, target)

Arguments

problem

An ae_problem.

target

A bound target (ae_bound_target).
